title: Causal Decoder, Masked Classifier, and Incremental Generation
prompt:
Build a compact decoder-only language model and use it for two downstream paths. `TinyCausalLM(vocab_size, embed_dim, max_seq_len)` must map integer token ids with shape `(batch, length)` to vocabulary logits `(batch, length, vocab_size)`. It must use causal attention and positions based on `max_seq_len`, not the vocabulary size. `SequenceClassifier(lm, num_labels)` must return one logit vector per sequence and average only positions whose `valid_mask` is True. Finally, `greedy_generate(model, prompt, steps, use_cache=True)` must append `steps` argmax tokens without changing the result when `use_cache` changes. An efficient implementation may retain past keys and values, but correctness comes first.

Use raw logits for training. Your modules should remain finite on short inputs, preserve batch dimensions, and allow gradients to reach the decoder parameters.

example.reasoning: A decoder produces a vocabulary distribution at every existing position.
